entries.clue: Key of Tchaikovsky's Piano Concerto No. 1
"He always asked a lot of questions"
Snack brand that sponsored Dale Earnhardt
"I used to catch him passing notes in class"
Don with a gift of gab
Having more hair on one's chest
Bank that may get in trouble?
Something to take when you're tired?

And others too numerous to mention
Addison's "How are thy Servants blest? O Lord!"

"He had a very special effect on me"
